title: EFC Closure Conjectures
abstract: Proposes two closure relations for Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC): the transition acceleration g† = c H0 / e and a galactic phase factor C = 2e − 1, both motivated by the Core Lock exponential structure. Using SPARC-derived g†, the paper predicts H0 = 70.2 ± 16.8 km/s/Mpc, consistent with Planck, SH0ES, and TRGB within current uncertainties. The conjectures are framed with explicit falsification criteria and remain to be validated by higher-precision measurements.
